name: Momentum Group Limited
summary: Momentum Group Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides insurance and financial services in South Africa and internationally. It operates through Momentum Retail, Momentum Investments, Metropolitan Life, Momentum Corporate, Momentum Health, Guardrisk, Momentum Insure, Momentum Africa, India, and Shareholders segments. The company offers long and short-term insurance; employee benefits; asset management, property management, investments, and savings; health administration services, such as managed care and wellness services.
